regression-poste.scope: Offline about:blank, isolated MemoryStorage, injected ratification; flat synthetic relay and ground stub. Real game model/UI/save/renderer. Not a real-map or hardware performance certification.

regression-mutuelle.scope: Real authored Radieuse interior with completed prerequisite injected through its model; actual E interaction, NPC choices, source preservation, save writes and reload. Scripted positioning and isolated MemoryStorage; software renderer, no real IGN traversal.

regression-radieuse.scope: Real authored interior, models, UI, native collision function, saves and software renderer. Injected setup and isolated MemoryStorage; synthetic exterior for portal round-trip, no real IGN exterior traversal.

browser.scope: Actual Radieuse interior, models, dialogue buttons, E inputs, save/load, visuals and collisions. Prerequisites through real quest reducers, scripted positions, isolated MemoryStorage. Software renderer; no human full-campaign or real IGN exterior validation.
